title: Living Birds
subtitle: Living Birds is a fully automated collection of realistic birds for any game
description:

Each bird is under 730 tris and includes 2 songs unique to its species. The system dynamically updates bird targets, spawning, unspawning, and all bird actions so you don't have to worry about anything.

NOW INCLUDING CROWS!


Features:
-AI driven realistic birds
-New collision avoidence system
-7 species, 14 unique birdsongs
-Pause independent of Time.timeScale
-dynamic bird target loading/unloading
-730 triangle models

The model includes a flying animation featuring wing-flapping movement, allowing the bird to be used in animated flight sequences and environmental wildlife scenes.

title: 3 Insects Pack
subtitle: 3 Animated Insects Pack
description:
Bring variety and movement to your 3D projects with this Animated Insects Pack, featuring three unique character models with distinctive designs and multiple animation clips.

This collection includes a clawed insect, an armored turtle, and a flying wasp-like insect. Each model features a stylized appearance, textured surfaces, and recognizable body details, making the pack suitable for fantasy games, adventure environments, enemy encounters, and animated scenes.

The Clawbug features a brown segmented body, multiple legs, and large front claws. The Turtle comes with a green body and a protective, spiked shell, while the flying insect features transparent wings, a dark body, and a red-and-black striped abdomen.

The pack includes various animation clips covering movement, idle behavior, attacks, reactions, and additional character actions.

Included 3D Models:

Clawbug – Brown insect with multiple legs and large claws

Flying Wasp – Winged insect with a striped abdomen

title: Insects 2
subtitle: 2 Non-Animated Insect 3D Models
description:
Add variety to your 3D environments with this Non-Animated Insects Pack, featuring two distinctive insect models with textured surfaces and detailed body designs.

This collection includes a grasshopper-like insect and a colorful butterfly, each offering a different visual style for nature-themed games, outdoor environments, and decorative 3D scenes.

The grasshopper-like insect features an elongated segmented body, earthy brown and green tones, angular legs, and pointed body details. The butterfly model features large orange wings with black borders, white markings, intricate wing patterns, and a contrasting blue-toned body.

Both models are non-animated and can be used as static environmental objects or visual elements in your projects.

**Included 3D Models:**
- Grasshopper-Like Insect – Segmented body, angular legs, and natural earthy colors
- Butterfly – Colorful orange and black patterned wings with detailed markings

**Key Features:**
- 2 unique textured 3D insect models
- Distinctive body shapes and surface details
- Colorful butterfly wing patterns
- Suitable for static environmental placement
- Non-animated models

**Perfect For:**
- Nature and wildlife games
- Forest and garden environments
- Adventure and exploration games
- Insect-themed environments
- Decorative 3D scenes and renders

Enhance your outdoor and nature-themed environments with these two distinctive insect models.
